lessons.title: A club shaped by its first names
lessons.subtitle: Atlante’s early identity grew from neighborhood football in Mexico City.

story.title: A corner in 1916
story.body: Chivas’ historical account places the beginning on 18 April 1916, near the corner of Sinaloa and Valladolid streets, where brothers Trinidad and Refugio Martínez led a group of young players.

story.title: Names before Atlante
story.body: The side first called itself Sinaloa, then Lusitania and U-53. Refugio Martínez proposed Atlante as the team’s enduring name.

facts.label: Atlante founding date
facts.prompt: On what date does Atlante’s history account place the club’s beginning?
facts.scope: The Chivas historical article’s stated date for the club’s origin.
facts.evidence: The article says the history began on 18 April 1916 near Sinaloa and Valladolid.

facts.label: Atlante first name
facts.prompt: What name did the group use first before later becoming Atlante?
facts.scope: The first club name in the opponent-club historical account.
facts.evidence: The account traces the sequence from Sinaloa to Lusitania and U-53 before Atlante.

facts.label: Atlante name proposer
facts.prompt: Who proposed the name Atlante after the earlier names were dropped?
facts.scope: Name change in the origin story.
facts.evidence: The source attributes the proposal to Refugio Martínez, nicknamed “El Vaquero”.

lessons.title: The first league crown
lessons.subtitle: Atlante’s 1946–47 title preceded its later Cancún-era championships.

story.title: A champion eleven
story.body: Atlante’s first Liga title came in the 1946–47 season. The historical account names Horacio Casarín among the players in that champion side.

story.title: Before the modern era
story.body: This title came decades before Atlante’s 1992–93 and Apertura 2007 league crowns.

facts.label: Atlante first league crown
facts.prompt: Which season does the historical account name for Atlante’s first Liga championship?
facts.scope: Atlante’s first league championship season.
facts.evidence: The article identifies 1946–47 as the club’s first league title.

facts.label: Named player in 1946–47 side
facts.prompt: Which forward appears in the source’s named 1946–47 champion lineup?
facts.scope: Named player in the historical champion lineup.
facts.evidence: Horacio Casarín is included in the eleven-name champion lineup.

facts.label: Other Atlante league title
facts.prompt: Which of these later seasons is listed as an Atlante league title by the source?
facts.scope: A later league title, distinct from 1946–47.
facts.evidence: The title list names 1992–93 and Apertura 2007 after 1946–47.

lessons.title: A title in the first Cancún season
lessons.subtitle: A change of home was followed by a championship run in Apertura 2007.

story.title: New home, same club
story.body: Atlante announced its move to Quintana Roo in May 2007. Its first tournament in Cancún ended with a home final against Pumas.

story.title: The decisive return
story.body: After a scoreless first leg, Atlante won the return 2–1 and earned its third league championship.

facts.label: Move announcement date
facts.prompt: In which month and year did Atlante announce it would play in Quintana Roo?
facts.scope: Announcement date for the move, as reported in the historical account.
facts.evidence: The article dates the announcement to 14 May 2007.

facts.prompt: What was the score in Atlante’s Apertura 2007 final return against Pumas?
facts.scope: Return-leg score only; this is not the aggregate. Atlante is listed first.
facts.evidence: Pumas’ official history says Atlante won the return 2–1 at Estadio Andrés Quintana Roo.

facts.label: Atlante title count
facts.prompt: How did the 2007 championship rank among Atlante’s Liga titles in the historical account?
facts.scope: The 2007 crown’s position in the club’s league-title sequence.
facts.evidence: The source calls the Apertura 2007 crown Atlante’s third league championship.
